description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/earthquakes/recent (base $0.002; USDC on Base only); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET ?hours=24&minmag=4.5 (hours 1-720, minmag -1 to 10; optional lat, lon and radiusKm 1-2000 together, limit 1-500, order=time|magnitude). 404 no_events = valid empty result, not charged.. Recent earthquakes: up to 500 USGS catalog events from the last 1 to 720 hours, by minimum magnitude and optional point and radius. Returns id, magnitude, place, time, coordinates, depth, review status, PAGER alert, tsunami flag and USGS event link, newest or largest first. Data: U.S. Geological Survey (public domain). Not a warning service. No events, bad input or source down: not charged. USDC on Base only.
